migration.name: Unified PostgreSQL, Redis, Better Auth, and Pricing migration

testSeams.name: unified_application
testSeams.description: Authenticated Next.js pages, route handlers, and server actions backed by real Dockerized PostgreSQL and Redis; outcomes are observed through public reads and rendered application behavior.

testSeams.name: migration_cli
testSeams.description: Immutable SQLite and Convex fixtures are processed through public extraction, staging, transformation, and reconciliation commands backed by real Dockerized PostgreSQL.

tasks.title: Local PostgreSQL and Redis runtime
tasks.delivers: A persistent local Docker Compose environment for PostgreSQL 16+ and Redis, service health checks, migrations, and isolated test databases.
acceptanceCriteria: PostgreSQL and Redis start from one pnpm command and report healthy.
Application, worker, migration, and test connection settings are documented without committing secrets.
An empty PostgreSQL database can apply every checked-in migration.
Redis can be deleted or restarted without losing canonical business data.

tasks.title: Fresh Better Auth and access administration
tasks.delivers: Fresh Better Auth sign-in, administrator bootstrap, staff provisioning, roles, capabilities, overrides, and consistent shadcn administration surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: No legacy Convex or SQLite identity row is imported.
The first administrator can be provisioned exactly once through an explicit command.
Authenticated capability checks protect reads and writes at the server boundary.
Access administration uses shared @workspace/ui shadcn primitives and the existing dashboard design system.

tasks.title: Complete bounded-context schema
tasks.delivers: All catalog, sales, manufacturing, workforce, quality, maintenance, audit, derived-state, and migration structures from an empty PostgreSQL database.
acceptanceCriteria: All tables in the approved logical target model exist with constraints and indexes.
Money and rates use numeric types and business dates and instants use their specified PostgreSQL types.
Canonical rows carry organization, version, actor, and source-provenance fields where required.
Database roles and least-privilege grants are migration tested.

tasks.title: Immutable source acquisition and staging
tasks.delivers: Verified manifests, identity exclusion, checksums, file inventory, idempotent SQLite staging, and idempotent Convex staging.
acceptanceCriteria: Source artifacts are explicit, checksummed, immutable, and never committed.
All legacy identity tables are recorded but excluded from working staging.
Rerunning either loader does not duplicate staging or canonical rows.
Malformed, unsafe, or incomplete artifacts fail before canonical writes.

tasks.title: Pricing transformation and reconciliation
tasks.delivers: All Pricing SQLite business tables in canonical PostgreSQL structures with source mappings, conflicts, counts, hashes, and known exceptions.
acceptanceCriteria: All 41 business SQLite tables are transformed or explicitly reconciled as empty, and all 3 identity tables remain excluded.
Source identifiers map idempotently to application-generated UUIDs.
Financial, relationship, and workflow reconciliation preserves known source findings.
File references are inventoried and unresolved files enter a review queue.

tasks.title: Convex transformation and reconciliation
tasks.delivers: Every canonical Convex table and known dataEntries type, correction resolution, production-overlap reporting, and unknown-type failure gates.
acceptanceCriteria: All canonical physical tables and approved logical entry types are mapped.
Unknown non-approved entry types block completeness acceptance.
Corrections resolve through source mappings or remain visible in conflict queues.
software_raw and productionEntries overlap is reported without silently dropping either source.

tasks.title: Enquiry-to-design workflow on PostgreSQL
tasks.delivers: Customers, enquiries, imports, clarification, technical review, design handoff, attachments, and matching without changing workflow behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing enquiry and design state transitions behave identically through public application interfaces.
Workflow writes are transactional and authorized through Better Auth capabilities.
Imports and attachment metadata are safe, observable, and idempotent where applicable.
Pages use the dashboard design system and shared shadcn primitives.

tasks.title: Product costing and quote workflow on PostgreSQL
tasks.delivers: Products, BOMs, package and assembly snapshots, Excel-equivalent costing, quote history, sending, and active-price invariants.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing costing formulas match known worked examples without functional modification.
Sent quote history is immutable and active price uniqueness remains lineage scoped.
Package and assembly snapshots retain the source immediate-child structure.
Money calculations preserve declared decimal precision and rounding behavior.

tasks.title: Purchase order and proforma-invoice workflow on PostgreSQL
tasks.delivers: PO import and matching, ambiguity handling, quote revision requests, PI lifecycle, and Q-to-M/P conversion.
acceptanceCriteria: Ambiguous customer codes never auto-match across product lineages.
PI approval activates the correct quote and performs existing product conversion atomically.
Historical sent documents use historical quote snapshots.
Cancellation and correction behavior remains auditable.

tasks.title: Bulk revision, ECN, and pricing corrections
tasks.delivers: Lineage-aware supersession, recursive affected-price updates, immutable revisions, and reversal and audit behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Direct, package, assembly, and nested-parent prices follow source revision rules.
Historical quote snapshots are never rewritten by later child changes.
Every correction is append-only and resolves or remains visibly quarantined.
The ported Pricing workflow audit reports no new findings.

tasks.title: Dashboard masters, work orders, and planning writes
tasks.delivers: Normalized masters, routes, setups, planning events, machine assignment stability, and current planning behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: All current master and planning mutations have PostgreSQL equivalents.
Machine and setup locks are enforced in the write transaction.
Planning algorithms remain functionally unchanged.
Every accepted planning-impacting write creates durable refresh work.

tasks.title: Production and shop-floor workflows
tasks.delivers: Production entry, production cards, machine locks, setup progression, dispatch, setup completion, and corrections.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing production and shop-floor transitions pass public-interface tests.
Actual production locks and explicit machine switches retain current rules.
Conflicting production sources remain reconciled and traceable.
Reversals preserve immutable source and actor evidence.

tasks.title: Workforce, quality, and maintenance workflows
tasks.delivers: Attendance, training, inspections, hourly checks, setup checklists, maintenance schedules and tasks, and their corrections.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing workforce, quality, and maintenance workflows use normalized repositories.
Quality parameters and checklist identities are relationally constrained.
Maintenance schedules reference physical machines and preserve task history.
Specialized screens use bounded PostgreSQL reads.

tasks.title: Durable refresh worker and Redis invalidation
tasks.delivers: Transactional outbox events, coalesced jobs, retry-safe read models, bounded polling, optional caching, and disposable Redis invalidation.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical writes and durable refresh jobs commit atomically in PostgreSQL.
Worker retries do not duplicate read-model versions.
Redis accelerates invalidation and rate limiting but is not required for correctness.
Refresh lag, failure, and retry state are observable.

tasks.title: Dashboard read cutover
tasks.delivers: PostgreSQL-backed dashboard screens and removal of runtime dependence on Convex subscriptions and snapshot chunks.
acceptanceCriteria: The main dashboard reads versioned derived state without chunk serialization.
Specialized screens query bounded normalized projections.
Client invalidation and polling recover from Redis loss.
Source fixtures produce equivalent operational views.

tasks.title: Remove legacy runtime dependencies
tasks.delivers: Zero production imports or reads from Convex and better-sqlite3, migrated file metadata, and honest compatibility routes.
acceptanceCriteria: No runtime code imports Convex client or server packages.
No production code imports better-sqlite3 or reads pricing_app.db.
Compatibility routes expose real behavior or explicit unsupported errors.
Old sources remain untouched read-only evidence.

tasks.title: Full rehearsals, rollback, and local acceptance
tasks.delivers: Two deterministic rehearsals, reconciliation reports, backup and restore proof, workflow smoke tests, and cutover and rollback command sheets.
acceptanceCriteria: Two consecutive runs produce identical counts and hashes.
PostgreSQL backup and restore is proven locally.
Pricing and critical manufacturing workflows pass end to end.
The requested business-logic audit starts from a verified baseline.

tasks.title: Freeze Pricing behavior and reconciliation fixtures
tasks.delivers: Executable source-characterization tests, deterministic PostgreSQL workflow fixtures, output golden fixtures, and explicit resolutions for known source-versus-target contradictions.
acceptanceCriteria: All 45 executable Pricing regression test cases plus the canonical costing boundary map to 46 behavior-oriented target test IDs, and all 57 workflow audit checks have unique target IDs.
Archived List, Package, Assembly, quote, PO, bulk-revision, and ECN relationships have deterministic PostgreSQL fixtures.
JSON, XLSX, PDF metadata, file, and route behavior have stable golden fixtures without committing source archives or secrets.
Executable source behavior is recorded as authoritative for active-price supersession and deterministic ranked PO matching, with archive anomalies retained as visible exceptions.

tasks.title: Correct commercial authorization and behavioral drift
tasks.delivers: Exact Better Auth capability boundaries, source-compatible active-price and import behavior, quote-send follow-ups, complete audit side effects, and source-safe correction reversals.
acceptanceCriteria: Orders, quotes, revisions, corrections, and every narrower commercial route enforce their dedicated read/write capabilities.
Active prices supersede using the executable source scopes under transactional locking.
Enquiry imports never auto-create all rows and instead persist source classifications and explicit idempotent review decisions.
Quote sending creates exactly one 15-day follow-up and source-safe reversals coexist with historical-change quarantine.

tasks.title: Customer and pricing-master maintenance
tasks.delivers: Source-equivalent customer CRUD, pricing/design/website/terms master CRUD, and atomic multi-sheet workbook template/import workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: An empty organization can bootstrap every required customer and commercial master through authorized shadcn screens.
Source defaults, uniqueness, grade and rod material lookup, term ordering, activation, and actor auditing are preserved.
Workbook sheets, aliases, transformations, duplicate behavior, error reporting, filename, and atomicity match the source.
A source master fixture round-trips through target export/import without canonical differences.

tasks.title: Enquiry, Sales, Technical Review, and follow-up parity
tasks.delivers: Complete enquiry and line lifecycle, drawing replacement/download, import review, Sales and Technical queues, clarification decisions, follow-ups, and enquiry/register outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Enquiry and line edit/delete gates, post-handover resets, drawing history, and authenticated file delivery match the source.
CSV/XLS/XLSX import classification and all row decisions produce identical states, links, clarifications, and idempotency.
Sales matching, Technical Review checklist ordering, queue transitions, and manual/chained follow-ups preserve source behavior.
Enquiry spreadsheet/register views, templates, and exports match golden headers, ordering, filters, omissions, and filenames.

tasks.title: Full Design dossier and workflow handoffs
tasks.delivers: Dedicated Design queues, complete dossier and files, portfolio/package selection, Q/C allocation, nested BOM editing, clarifications, costing handoff, and safe reversal behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: All Design fields, requirements, costs, approval fields, internal/customer/CAD files, locks, and queue states are available in the target.
List, Package, nested Assembly, and existing-portfolio flows produce source-equivalent identities, products, BOM rows, and transitions.
Only valid Assembly nesting and internal ordered components are accepted, with source material/process fallback behavior.
Technical/Design/Costing clarification directions and handoff reversal preserve blockers and correction evidence.

tasks.title: Complete costing, pricing registers, and quote documents
tasks.delivers: Full product and customer costing workbenches, Product and Assembly registers, pricing/revision spreadsheets, quote sending, and historical quote PDF generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Every source costing input, default, process guard, backflow, package/assembly editor, and one-piece-grams meaning is preserved.
Formula intermediates, source derived-cost persistence, rounding, and immutable snapshot trees match exact storage precision.
Current pricing and revision registers and XLSX outputs match source datasets, filters, columns, omissions, and filenames.
Historical quote PDFs select source-equivalent rows and preserve live Westmetall/Frankfurter fallback behavior through deterministic adapters.

tasks.title: Complete PO/PI files, reports, and order side effects
tasks.delivers: PO source-file lifecycle, source-compatible matching, all PO/PI reports, exact quote-to-order conversion, Drawing History creation, and Website Product creation.
acceptanceCriteria: PO upload/download, unmatched, Keep Our Price, Accept PO Price, ranked-match, PI issue/send/approve, and pre-approval cancellation match source outcomes.
PI lines retain exact historical quote IDs and prices, and approved PI records remain immutable and non-cancellable.
Q conversion recursively preserves source M/P identity behavior and creates complete drawing, website, assembly-sync, actor, and audit side effects atomically.
PO template/detail, PI PDF/XLSX, PO master, and approved-PI exports match golden sheets, fields, formatting, selection, and filenames.

tasks.title: Full bulk revisions, ECN, and corrections
tasks.delivers: All source bulk field matrices and staging behavior, complete ECN Design/Product Costing/decision stages, and unified correction candidate, reversal, log, and quarantine workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: Customer and product bulk routes retain exact field allowlists, percentage conventions, process aliases, previews, multi-select staging, deletion, and completion-once behavior.
ECNs retain Pending Design, Pending Product Costing, Pending Costing, and Completed states with complete product/BOM changes and one decision per affected price.
Direct, Package, Assembly, and two-level nested fixtures revise child-before-parent exactly once without changing historical digests.
Source-safe correction reversals and technical-revision evidence share one register while forbidden history changes remain visibly quarantined.

tasks.title: Website, drawing, analytics, and remaining registers
tasks.delivers: Complete Drawing History and Website Product maintenance/exports, source Pricing dashboard analytics, Sales history, and every remaining register/filter/export.
acceptanceCriteria: Drawing revision/date/laminated-quantity maintenance and export retain source uniqueness, date display, columns, and filenames.
Website part codes, category combinations, materials, thread standards, six assembly slots, completion status, and export match source rules.
Every source dashboard metric, aging bucket, trend, Pareto, workflow load, quote mix, and material lead-time definition reconciles against archived data.
No Pricing source screen, register, history view, or output remains unaccounted for; adjacent HR is recorded as an external proxy dependency because no HR repository/data was supplied.

tasks.title: Full business-logic acceptance and source retirement readiness
tasks.delivers: End-to-end parity proof across PostgreSQL, Redis-loss behavior, Better Auth, files, documents, exports, responsive shadcn UI, archived data, and source-runtime retirement readiness.
acceptanceCriteria: All 74 source write entry points, 63 routes/pages, 46 regression/formula oracles, 57 workflow checks, source tables, screens, and outputs are implemented or explicitly accounted for.
The full Enquiry-to-PI-to-internal-product/drawing/website lifecycle and revision workflows pass repository, HTTP, browser, accessibility, desktop, and 390px tests.
All migrated file metadata resolves, local ignored attachment bytes have proven backup/restore commands, and every file route passes traversal and authorization tests.
PostgreSQL remains canonical with Redis stopped; no runtime SQLite or Convex import exists; all tests, typechecks, lint, production build, data reconciliation, and source-retirement gates pass.

tasks.title: Bound PostgreSQL connections and separate runtime secrets
tasks.delivers: Shared bounded PostgreSQL pools and separate validated web, worker, migration, reporting, and test identities.
acceptanceCriteria: Repositories accept injected pools and managed web calls reuse a Vercel-attached module-scope pool.
Worker and migration callers use separately bounded or direct-only identities with redacted metrics.
Hosted validation rejects local, plaintext, pooled-migration, or role-mismatched credentials without exposing values.

tasks.title: Establish the Neon staging foundation and least privilege
tasks.delivers: An isolated PostgreSQL 16 Neon staging target with the full schema, accepted safety settings, and least-privilege login roles.
acceptanceCriteria: Redacted preflight proves target isolation, TLS, protection, capacity, retention, and the repository migration head.
Web, worker, migration, and reporting login identities pass positive and negative privilege checks.
No provider identifier or credential is written to the repository or ledger.

tasks.title: Connect the disposable Redis contract to Upstash
tasks.delivers: An isolated Upstash database and connectionless Redis adapter preserving atomic fail-open rate limiting and PostgreSQL outbox authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Hosted runtime requires server-only Upstash REST credentials and never falls back to localhost.
Rate limiting is atomic and fail-open; dashboard versions remain monotonic and failed publication remains retryable.
Provider policy and live smoke evidence are recorded only in redacted form.

tasks.title: Rehearse deterministic local-to-Neon transfer twice
tasks.delivers: Two measured direct-TLS dump/restore rehearsals with exact data, identity, schema, and privilege reconciliation.
acceptanceCriteria: The frozen source applies every migration before a checksummed custom-format dump.
Both empty non-authoritative restore targets exactly match every table fingerprint and schema/privilege gate.
Representative auth, business, worker, audit, and attachment gates pass.

tasks.title: Cut the hosted staging app and worker to managed services
tasks.delivers: Source-controlled staging web and bounded worker operation against Neon and Upstash without local containers.
acceptanceCriteria: Hosted auth, business writes, reads, exports, audit attribution, responsive browser routes, and worker/outbox flow pass.
The same canonical flows pass with Upstash unavailable and connection use remains within budget.
Stopping local Docker services does not affect hosted staging.

tasks.title: Make managed capacity, lag, and spend observable
tasks.delivers: Redacted Neon, pool, worker/outbox, Redis fallback, Upstash capacity, and budget observability.
acceptanceCriteria: Connection saturation, queue/outbox lag, Redis fallback, provider usage, and budget headroom are visible.
Protection, retention, backup, eviction, and budget settings are included in periodic preflight.
Logs and alerts contain no provider identifiers, credentials, or business payloads.

tasks.title: Prove Neon restore, PITR rollback, and empty-Redis recovery
tasks.delivers: Verified isolated custom restore, reversible Neon PITR drill, and PostgreSQL-driven empty-Redis recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Restored PostgreSQL state exactly matches the source fingerprint and privilege contract.
PITR and its reversal affect only verification targets and record the effective recovery window.
An empty Redis recovers without affecting authentication, authorization, or canonical writes.

tasks.title: Deliver hosted staging and close the managed migration ledger
tasks.delivers: Complete hosted-staging acceptance and a redacted closed Neon/Upstash migration ledger without production promotion.
acceptanceCriteria: All repository, provider, hosted browser, failure, and recovery gates pass from the staging branch.
Neon matches the frozen source and least-privilege web/worker operation is proved.
NU-01 through NU-08 and their evidence are recorded without secrets; production promotion remains unperformed.

changeLog.summary: Created the approved local task ledger, dependency edges, and two public TDD seams.
Added a public runtime verification test; it failed because the local runtime contract did not exist.

Added persistent PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 7 Docker services, an isolated test database, a runtime verification command, and environment contracts. The integration test passed against both live containers.

pnpm local:up applied 7 migrations and reported both services ready. PostgreSQL retained all migration state while Redis was stopped and remained valid after Redis restarted. Runtime lint, focused type-check, test, and Docker Compose validation passed.
Confirmed the fresh-identity boundary, Better Auth PostgreSQL adapter contract, capability seed, Next.js server-side authorization boundary, and shared shadcn administration primitives.
Added an application-seam integration test for capability-gated staff provisioning and credential authentication; it failed because the access administration service did not exist.
Added a second application-seam test for role grants, effective capabilities, explicit deny and allow overrides, and the administration snapshot; it failed at the missing role-management behavior.

Implemented capability-gated Better Auth staff provisioning, PostgreSQL application roles and permissions, user overrides, stable administration snapshots, protected Next.js server actions, and a shared-shadcn access administration surface.

Live PostgreSQL auth and access tests passed, including one-time administrator promotion, staff credential authentication, deny precedence, explicit allow, and unauthorized provisioning. Focused lint, formatting, DB and web type-checks, and the Next.js production build passed. Browser verification covered redirect and sign-in, authenticated rendering, a real staff-provision server action, no framework errors, correct navigation state, and a 390px layout with no horizontal overflow.

Expanded the logical schema contract into canonical tables for every approved bounded context, including relational planner event details and the previously implicit proforma-invoice aggregate required by the Pricing workflow.
Added an empty-database schema contract for all 95 canonical tables; it failed with only 11 tables present.

Added migration 0008 with the complete catalog, sales, manufacturing, workforce, quality, maintenance, and audit model; relational planner detail tables; PI aggregates; source provenance; actor/version columns; constraints and indexes; and separate migration, web, worker, and reporting roles.

Eleven empty-database contracts passed for all 95 tables, approved PostgreSQL types, shared mutable columns, active-price lineage, active-machine locking, quality scope, and least-privilege grants. Package lint and type-check passed, and pnpm local:up upgraded the persistent database to 8 migrations while PostgreSQL and Redis remained healthy.

Audited the existing SQLite and Convex inspectors and idempotent staging loaders against the immutable-artifact gate; identified archive-path and full-JSONL validation as the remaining pre-write safety gap.
Added inspector tests for path traversal, missing Convex dataEntries, and malformed canonical JSONL; both source inspectors accepted unsafe archive content before the safety layer existed.

Added normalized archive-path validation, duplicate-path detection, required Convex dataEntries enforcement, complete JSONL validation, identity and derived-state disposition evidence, and safe idempotent staging for immutable SQLite and Convex artifacts.

Verified the untouched 2026-07-18 exports by SHA-256 (Pricing ZIP 40e6d256dc1279b343951c3024efb0470663e0cf4d546537318c888b25bd190b, SQLite cda45d16fcd50908b94b84e2958c30cd32c33e28c5f0b0ea80d78f414fc43cb3, Convex e31158f68b082af720c9d36816ce967de181c1132f1f8867f5e642dc068409d3). Run aa040457-b12e-461d-add0-d6ac647a6495 staged 17 populated Pricing business tables and 13,752 Convex rows (13,524 dataEntries plus physical-table rows), preserved three source relationship conflicts, recorded 654 legacy identity rows and 39 archive-only rows in manifests, and staged zero identity documents. Seven migration tests, lint, type-check, and formatting passed.

Corrected the source contract to 44 total SQLite tables: 41 business tables plus 3 excluded identity tables. The 17 populated business tables must produce 628 source mappings and matching source/target payload hashes; the other 24 require explicit zero-row reconciliation.

Added a public migration-CLI integration test covering all 17 populated Pricing table shapes, preservation of costing and catalog fields, row mappings, hashes, reconciliation, and rerun stability. It failed because the complete snapshot transformer did not exist.

Added migration 0009 and the complete Pricing snapshot transformer. It preserves legacy-only costing and master fields, transforms all 17 populated tables, maps and SHA-256 verifies each source payload, reconciles every canonical table, queues unresolved file references, and keeps known relationship conflicts visible.

Two real-source rehearsals (d439181a-cb6a-4d10-9e22-72a7c287673f and 6c61848a-5f16-4d1b-a223-c9a40a3d8ece) each passed 41 of 41 table checks with 628 source rows, 628 target rows, 628 mappings, and 628 matching hashes. All 625 versioned targets remained at row_version 1 after the second rehearsal; three source FK conflicts remained explicit and zero file references required quarantine. Eight migration tests, 11 empty-database contracts, lint, type-check, formatting, and the nine-migration local runtime check passed.

Fixed the real-source transformation contract at 13,751 canonical Convex rows: 13,523 logical dataEntries plus 228 populated physical-table rows. The single _summary row remains archive-only; rejection_classification follows its approved typed-quarantine rule; every other observed type maps to a relational target with source mappings and hashes.

Added a migration-CLI integration test for relational part/route/setup normalization, exact decimal setup-code preservation, physical production, typed quarantine, correction resolution, overlap reporting, hashes, and rerun idempotency. It failed because the Convex snapshot transformer did not exist.

Added migration 0010 and the complete Convex snapshot transformer. It normalizes every observed logical and physical source type, preserves decimal setup codes, reports competing production sources, resolves corrections into auditable reversals, explicitly quarantines approved typed exceptions, and fails on unknown types, count gaps, or hash mismatches.

Two real-source rehearsals (44da427c-4759-4989-b649-9c03931d564c and ed43f349-6bef-4d52-b508-b9021bdfafc1) each reconciled 13,751 canonical Convex rows with 13,751 source mappings and matching hashes, 205 resolved corrections, 69 approved typed quarantines, zero orphan corrections, zero unknown entry types, three physical production rows, and zero software_raw rows. The single _summary row remained archive-only and all 17 versioned Convex target groups stayed at row_version 1.

Audited the recovered Pricing enquiry, handover, technical review, clarification, design, import, matching, and attachment rules. Fixed the PostgreSQL service seam around one transaction client and the Next.js mutation seam around per-action capability checks.

Added a PostgreSQL integration contract for enquiry creation, commercial-term handover gates, clarification lifecycle, design-to-costing handoff, safe attachment metadata, idempotent imports, and portfolio matching. It failed because the commercial workflow repository did not exist.

Added migration 0011, the transactional commercial workflow repository, capability-protected Server Actions, local attachment persistence, and shared-shadcn enquiry screens. The recovered monthly numbering, handover gates, six-key technical checklist, clarification reuse, design branches, imports, matching, and audit behavior now run on PostgreSQL without a SQLite runtime dependency.

The real-PostgreSQL workflow suite passed alongside all database tests (13 tests total); database and web typechecks, lint, and the production build passed. A real Better Auth browser session created ENQ-2607-001 against the migrated customer/product data, added a line, handed it over, opened and resolved a Sales clarification, persisted all six technical gates as Feasible, and produced actor-linked audit events. Desktop and 390px checks had no page errors or horizontal overflow.

Audited the recovered product-parameter costing, exact workbook chain, draft replacement, sent immutability, active-price lineage, and recursive package/assembly quote rules. PostgreSQL NUMERIC remains the exact storage boundary; the legacy JavaScript calculation order is preserved, and a partial unique index owns the one-active-price invariant.

Added a real-PostgreSQL integration contract for material-rate defaults, Barstock and package costing branches, workbook outputs, editable drafts, immutable sent snapshots, lineage supersession, and immediate-child package/assembly snapshots. It fails because the commercial costing repository does not exist.

Implemented the shared Pricing calculation module and transactional PostgreSQL costing repository. The focused real-database contract now passes material defaults, explicit pieces-per-kilogram and weight derivation, Barstock zero-forging behavior, draft upsert, recursive package quotes, sent immutability, and lineage-scoped active-price supersession.

Added migration 0012 with exact quote inputs/results, calculation and product snapshots, nested child-quote links, the partial one-active-lineage index, and database triggers protecting sent quote trees. Added capability-protected costing and send actions plus shared-shadcn product-parameter, quote-register, and quote-detail screens. The pure calculation subpath keeps PostgreSQL drivers out of the client bundle.

All database tests passed (16 tests), database and web typechecks passed, database lint passed, web lint retained only three pre-existing React Compiler warnings, the focused browser calculation tests passed, and the Next.js production build passed with local environment values. A real Better Auth browser session completed M1 product costing, saved ENQ-2607-001-M1 at USD 1.235625, marked it Sent and active, and verified actor-linked quote.saved/quote.sent audit events, no console errors, and no horizontal overflow at 390px.

Recovered the Pricing PO matcher, explicit price decisions, unmatched quote-request reuse, PI transitions, Q-to-M/P conversion, immediate package-child conversion, and cancellation rules. Tightened the recovered matcher so a customer code spanning multiple active lineages is always Ambiguous.

Added a real-PostgreSQL integration contract for ambiguous lineages, matched and differing prices, revision requests, atomic workbook imports, reusable PO quote requests, immutable issued PI lines, PI approval, permanent product conversion, and approved-order cancellation protection. It initially failed at the missing commercial-orders repository.

Implemented the transactional commercial-orders repository and migrations 0013-0014. PO lines retain PO and historical system values, revision requests remain visible, PI lines retain exact quote IDs and prices, issued documents are immutable, and approval activates quotes plus converts Q identities inside one transaction.

Added capability-protected Server Actions, atomic Excel worksheet import, and shared-shadcn purchase-order register and detail routes for matching, ambiguity, price decisions, quote requests, PI generation/sending/approval, and auditable cancellation.

All 20 database tests, database and web typechecks, database lint, and the Next.js production build passed; web lint retained only three pre-existing React Compiler warnings. A real Better Auth session created PO-BROWSER-260721-1, matched BROWSER-001 at USD 1.235625, generated/sent/approved its PI, retained the exact quote ID, activated and accepted the quote, and produced five actor-linked audit events. Fresh-session browser checks showed the source date unchanged in Asia/Kolkata, no page errors, and no horizontal overflow at 390px.

Recovered the Pricing bulk-revision and ECN state machines, field eligibility, percentage normalization, recursively affected customer prices, child-to-parent supersession order, and correction semantics. The PostgreSQL port preserves these rules without rewriting historical quote snapshots.

Added a real-PostgreSQL integration contract for leaf, assembly, and nested-package propagation; immutable source snapshot digests; ECN design and keep-or-revise decisions; and visible destructive-correction quarantine. It initially failed because the commercial-revisions repository did not exist.

Implemented migration 0015 and the transactional revision repository. Completion creates inactive draft replacements, clones snapshots/components/terms, supersedes sources, activates sent replacements, recalculates nested parents child-first, records append-only ECN decisions, and quarantines destructive correction requests with audit events.

Added capability-protected Server Actions and a shared-shadcn Price revisions workbench for creating/staging/completing bulk revisions, separate ECN design and costing stages, eligible customer-price selection, and visible pricing-correction quarantine. Added the route to the commercial navigation and the correction table to the canonical schema contract.

All 23 database tests and database/web typechecks passed; database lint passed and web lint retained only three pre-existing React Compiler warnings. A real Better Auth browser session completed BPR-0002 from USD 1.235625 to 1.276813, completed ECN-0001 with a keep-price replacement at 1.276813, and created an actor-linked Quarantined deletion request. The page reported no runtime errors and no horizontal overflow at 390px.

Mapped the legacy machine, route, cycle, tooling, work-order, calendar, route-selection, priority, constraint, override, and route-change mutations to normalized PostgreSQL writes. Retained planner algorithms in the existing read layer while defining transaction locks and one coalesced durable dashboard refresh job per organization.

Added a real-PostgreSQL contract for business-key master upserts, route/setup identity, work orders, cycle/tooling/calendar records, route supersession, all four planner events, physical-machine locking, and coalesced refresh work. Extended it to fail while nested interrupted setups, queue blockers, placements, and remaining-route setups existed only in source JSON.

Implemented migration 0016 and createDashboardPlanningRepository. Master writes use advisory business-key locks and row locks; planner writes use work-order, route-selection, setup-state, and physical-machine locks; accepted writes atomically upsert one pending dashboard refresh job. Nested planner evidence now retains both the immutable source payload and joinable child rows.
